environment.virtualizer: same locally patched QEMU 11.1.3 WHPX build as v8; isolated socket Ethernet

method.noise_payload: one random payload reused per trial; invalid random UDP, not MAC1-valid handshake or captured-prefix floods
method.sender_and_arrival_rate: sender full-run mean within 1%; every offered packet counted independently at switch; entry delivery within 1%
method.arrival_timing: QPC timestamps before forwarding and 100-ms bins; first-to-last rate excludes final sender sleep
method.cpu_definition: first eight /proc/stat counters; busy is user+nice+system+irq+softirq divided by total, including idle/iowait/steal in denominator
method.measurement_window: complete samples between resident before/after TCP marks; noise begins about one second before first mark; TCP warmup/run plus two-second tail and any late sender completion
method.four_sample_windows: sliding sums of ticks, actual elapsed duration retained; no mean of percentages
method.measurement_overhead: resident detailed CPU/process collector and persistent fixed workload launch retained; no new SSH/sudo in CPU windows; collector CPU included
method.baselines: three clean controls, filtered and DNAT pilots, then three repetitions of DNAT/filter/filter+IFB with rotated/reversed order
method.baseline_policy: ordinary grouped filter plus unchanged 50k/5000 aggregate and 35k/3500 source-tuple kernel guard; no IFB
method.ifb_policy: same filter/guard plus TBF 200 Mbit/s, burst 65536 bytes, limit 1048576 bytes
method.dnat_policy: no experimental filter, guard or IFB
method.host_cpu_reference: one Windows logical CPU per process; total host uses 32 logical CPUs; guest threshold does not apply to host process percentages
method.public_data: aggregates, worst-window evidence and arrival bins; full resident/host/burst traces retained locally
